correctness.rationale: Degree-two original endpoints must differ. With three named colors all subdivision colors are uniquely forced, and the original bipartition classes must partition into nonempty odd-sized classes; counting those gives the displayed parity split. A parity checkerboard constructs the even-even four-color upper bound. For p=2 and even q each of six page triples is independent except two hubs. The nine excluded-color pairs and two sign parities give exact Fourier expression; the signed weight table yields the displayed closed count. Both standalone scripts run with the reported outputs: full direct enumeration and independent used-support/parity-mask dynamic programming.
